name: minimind
description: 🧠 Train a 64M-parameter LLM from scratch in just 2h!
one_liner: An open-source recipe and codebase that lets anyone train their own tiny AI language model from scratch, cheaply, in about two hours.
buyer: An AI bootcamp or university instructor who wants students to build a real LLM hands-on instead of just calling an API.
business_use_cases: An AI education company builds a paid course or workshop around 'train your own LLM in an afternoon.'
An ML consultancy uses it as a teaching sandbox for corporate AI-literacy training days.
A GPU hardware reseller bundles it as a hands-on demo to sell workstations to hobbyists and students.

money_ideas.idea: Sell seats in a cohort-based weekend course built around the repo.
Produce a paid video tutorial series walking through each training stage.

steal_this: Turn the repo into a guided, beginner-friendly weekend workshop — 'Build Your Own ChatGPT in a Weekend' — and sell seats to local hobbyists and students.
